claim: You can prevent image tags from being overwritten by turning on tag immutability in an ECR repository. In the console setting for Immutable, you can also enter tag names or wildcards in the Immutable tag exclusion text box to enable tag updates for a few immutable tags.

qualifiers.condition: the exclusion box is described in the console steps (Setting image tag mutability, AWS Management Console); the overview sentence of the same page still says tag immutability affects all tags

note: spot-19: the page contradicts itself: its overview says 'Tag immutability affects all tags. You cannot make some tags immutable while others aren't.', while the console and CLI sections describe Immutable tag exclusion and IMMUTABLE_WITH_EXCLUSION. Claim scoped to the console text box the quote describes.
